interpretation.proposal: Provide a hand-drawn musical system in which original visitor-made marks shape tempo, pitch and timbre instead of presenting another static music player.

idea.name: The Crooked Score
idea.description: A locally authored musical drawing surface integrated into the existing Music Room. Horizontal drawing location sets event time, vertical location selects pitch, drawing density sets dynamics. Web Audio is opt-in.
